Test for late data side output handling in merging windows (session windows)\n        // This test verifies that late-arriving elements are properly sent to the side output\n        // when using session windows with allowedLateness and sideOutputLateData configuration\n\n        final int sessionGap = 10; // 10 seconds gap between elements to create new session\n        final long allowedLateness = 5; // Allow 5 seconds of lateness\n\n        ListStateDescriptor<Tuple2<String, Integer>> stateDesc =\n                new ListStateDescriptor<>(\n                        \"window-contents\",\n                        STRING_INT_TUPLE.createSerializer(new SerializerConfigImpl()));\n\n        WindowOperatorFactory<\n                        String,\n =\n                        new WindowOperatorFactory<>(\n                                EventTimeSessionWindows.withGap(Duration.ofSeconds(sessionGap)),\n                                new TimeWindow.Serializer(),\n                                new TupleKeySelector(),\n                                BasicTypeInfo.STRING_TYPE_INFO.createSerializer(\n                                        new SerializerConfigImpl()),\n                                stateDesc,\n                                new InternalIterableWindowFunction<>(new PassThroughWindowFunction<>()),\n                                EventTimeTrigger.create(),\n                                allowedLateness * 1000, // Convert to milliseconds\n                                lateOutputTag);\n\n        OneInputStreamOperatorTestHarness<Tuple2<String, Integer>, Tuple2<String, Integer>>\n                testHarness = createTestHarness(operator);\n\n        testHarness.open();\n\n        ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Object> expectedOutput = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();\n        ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Object> expectedLateOutput = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();\n\n        // Create a session window:\n        // Element 1 at t=1000 creates window [1000, 1000+10000] = [1000, 11000]\n        // Element 2 at t=5000 falls within window [1000, 11000+10000-5000] range, causing merge\n        // Final window is [1000, 15000] (5000 + 10000)\n        testHarness.processElement(new StreamRecord<>(new Tuple2<>(\"key1\", 1), 1000));\n        testHarness.processElement(new StreamRecord<>(new Tuple2<>(\"key1\", 2), 5000));\n\n        // Advance watermark to 16000\n        // Window maxTimestamp=15000, cleanup time=15000+5000=20000\n        // Since watermark 16000 < cleanup time 20000, window is NOT cleaned up yet\n        testHarness.processWatermark(new Watermark(16000));\n\n        expectedOutput.add(new StreamRecord<>(new Tuple2<>(\"key1\", 1), 14999));\n        expectedOutput.add(new StreamRecord<>(new Tuple2<>(\"key1\", 2), 14999));\n        expectedOutput.add(new Watermark(16000));\n\n        TestHarnessUtil.assertOutputEqualsSorted(\n                \"Output was not correct.\",\n                expectedOutput,\n                testHarness.getOutput(),\n                new Tuple2ResultSortComparator());\n\n        testHarness.getOutput().clear();\n\n        // Advance watermark beyond cleanup time (>20000)\n        testHarness.processWatermark(new Watermark(21000));\n        expectedOutput.add(new Watermark(21000));\n\n        TestHarnessUtil.assertOutputEqualsSorted(\n                \"Output was not correct.\",\n                expectedOutput,\n                testHarness.getOutput(),\n                new Tuple2ResultSortComparator());\n\n        testHarness.getOutput().clear();\n\n        // Send a late element at t=8000\n        // isElementLate checks: 8000 + 5000 = 13000 <= 21000? YES - it's late!\n        // This late element should be sent to the side output\n        testHarness.processElement(new StreamRecord<>(new Tuple2<>(\"key1\", 3), 8000));\n\n Late elements skip the entire merge loop\n2. `isSkippedElement` remains `true`\n3. At line 447: `if (isSkippedElement && isElementLate(element))` now evaluates to `true`\n4. skip directly\n} else {\n    // Existing merge loop continues here...\n}\n```\n\n### Code Flow After Fix\n```\nprocessElement(element):\n  if (MergingWindowAssigner):\n    if (isElementLate(element)):  // CHECK EARLY\n      // Skip merge loop, isSkippedElement remains true\n    else:\n      for each window:\n        actualWindow = mergingWindows.addWindow(window)  // MERGE ONLY IF NOT LATE\n        if (isWindowLate(actualWindow)):\n          skip element\n        else:\n          process element\n\n  if (isSkippedElement && isElementLate(element)):  // WILL NOW BE TRUE FOR LATE ELEMENTS\n    sideOutput(element)  // ELEMENT IS PROPERLY SIDE-OUTPUT\n```\n\n## Key Improvements\n1. **Prevents unnecessary merges**: Late elements no longer trigger merge operations\n2. **Correct state handling**: No state modification occurs for elements that should be side-output\n3. **Proper side-output path**: Late elements are now correctly emitted to the configured side output\n4. **Non-breaking change**: Normal (non-late) elements follow the exact same logic as before\n\n## Test Case Added\n\n**File**: `/workspace/flink-streaming-java/src/test/java/org/apache/flink/streaming/runtime/operators/windowing/WindowOperatorTest.java`\n\n**Method**: `testSessionWindowsWithLateDataAndSideOutput()`\n\n### Test Scenario\n1.
